The explicit medial-identity witness forces S_a~S_(a+4b); the proposed rotation-singleton/reflection-mod-4A equivalence is compatible with multiplication and division. On the quotient all right translations commute because 4(A/4A)=0, hence it is medial and exactly the least medial congruence. Multiplicative cyclic-factor count follows. Twenty-four exhaustive finite closures match the formula; they only corroborate the algebraic proof.

value.rationale: This gives the exact universal medial congruence for the natural family of all inversion semidirect products A ⋊ C2, replacing lower bounds with a complete structural classification. The 4A reflection collapse and survival of rotations describe genuine mixed-operation structure, yielding natural finite counts for all abelian kernels. It explains non-class-two examples such as S3 as part of an infinite general pattern, rather than a numerical gain for one object.
